key_insight: GIFT selectively applies token-level teacher guidance based on its geometric compatibility with the reinforcement learning gradient.
engineering_relevance: GIFT offers a principled way to combine dense distillation with outcome-based RL while reducing conflicting updates during reasoning training.
method: Decompose distillation gradients into components parallel and orthogonal to the RL gradient to assess conflict and novel guidance.
Rank token-level guidance using these geometric signals, filtering conflicting updates while retaining complementary guidance at full strength.
Progressively reduce distillation coverage, transitioning to pure outcome-grounded RL at convergence.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over strong baselines across mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks and multiple model scales, with relative gains up to 9.5% on difficult math tasks.
watch_item: Token-level gradient analysis may add training overhead; the abstract does not quantify its computational cost.
paper_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
